name: USPTO Patent
description: Core data structure for a USPTO patent application or granted patent record

fields.name: applicationNumber
fields.description: USPTO application serial number assigned at filing

fields.name: patentNumber
fields.description: Granted patent number (null for pending applications). Prefix: US for utility, D for design, PP for plant, RE for reissue

fields.name: title
fields.description: Patent title as filed with the USPTO

fields.name: abstract
fields.description: Abstract describing the invention

fields.name: filingDate
fields.description: Date the patent application was filed with the USPTO

fields.name: publicationDate
fields.description: Pre-grant publication date (18 months after earliest effective filing date for most applications)

fields.name: grantDate
fields.description: Date the patent was granted, null for pending applications

fields.name: expirationDate
fields.description: Calculated patent expiration date (20 years from effective filing for utility patents)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current prosecution status

fields.name: patentType
fields.description: Type of patent application

fields.name: inventors
fields.description: Named inventors listed on the patent

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Inventor given name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Inventor family name

fields.name: city
fields.description: Inventor city of residence

fields.name: state
fields.description: Inventor state of residence

fields.name: country
fields.description: Inventor country of residence

fields.name: assignees
fields.description: Current owners or assignees of the patent rights

fields.name: name
fields.description: Assignee legal name

fields.name: entityType
fields.description: Entity type: INDIVIDUAL, COMPANY, UNIVERSITY, GOVERNMENT

fields.name: city
fields.description: Assignee city

fields.name: state
fields.description: Assignee state

fields.name: country
fields.description: Assignee country

fields.name: cpcClassifications
fields.description: Cooperative Patent Classification (CPC) codes assigned by the USPTO

fields.name: code
fields.description: CPC, USPC, or IPC classification code

fields.name: description
fields.description: Human-readable classification description

fields.name: classificationType
fields.description: Classification system: CPC, USPC, or IPC

fields.name: claims
fields.description: Patent claims defining the legal scope of protection

fields.name: claimNumber
fields.description: Claim number (1-based)

fields.name: claimType
fields.description: Claim type: INDEPENDENT or DEPENDENT

fields.name: dependsOn
fields.description: Parent claim number for dependent claims

fields.name: claimText
fields.description: Full text of the claim as filed

fields.name: prosecutionHistory
fields.description: Chronological record of USPTO examiner actions and applicant responses

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the action

fields.name: eventCode
fields.description: USPTO event code

fields.name: eventDescription
fields.description: Description of the action

fields.name: documentUrl
fields.description: URL to download the associated document
